concentration_sources.availability: Original disclosed equity values only after each SEC filing date's next actual Qlib session; report dates never used as availability. 2017 amendments verified unchanged. Held late 2025-Sep amendment verified unchanged and never overrides newer 2026-Mar report. Intraday first-public receipt is not certified, so the next-session rule is conservative.

single_mechanism.formula: sum over all 30 original disclosed EC securities of (original valUSD divided by that filing's sum of 30 EC valUSD)^2; use the latest publicly filed report available before each signal and no cross-sectional price data, gap fill, clipping, reporting-age threshold, percentile or post-outcome selection.
single_mechanism.hypothesis: A more concentrated reported SOXX fund basket reflects narrower semiconductor leadership and greater fragility; conditional on Stage1's original ETF-level inputs, it predicts a lower next-five-open SOXX return, so the candidate standardized coordinate coefficient must be negative. This is a distinct delayed-disclosure mechanism after the full-member new-low/downside price source failed its 0/780 coverage gate.
single_mechanism.regime_motivation: Frozen Stage1 0bp attribution found severe post-decline cash opportunity cost in the weak 2025-04-07..10-07 window, whereas 2024Q3 cash helped. The complete matched weak and good intervals motivate a better decision-time cash-versus-SOXX forecast, not a hindsight window switch. Keep the original Stage1 allocation/action/risk/recovery chain fixed for any later account.
single_mechanism.candidate: Same rows, label, imputer, scaler and Ridge plus one HHI coordinate from the qualified original SEC source map.

label.primary: Five consecutive original Stage1 SOXX funded open-to-open returns from signal s: sum j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j)).
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of the fifth interval; training rows mature strictly before 2023-01-01 New York, reused diagnostic rows before 2026-10-10 New York.
label.role: Matched incremental information only, not fee-net strategy return.

model.baseline: SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=1.0) on original 39 features
model.candidate: Identical pipeline plus one fixed HHI coordinate

information_gate.paired_metric: On identical held signal rows, baseline squared error minus candidate squared error for five-open SOXX log return.

barrier: First perform one no-fit DatasetH/source/maturity preflight. After exact-plan/code review, execute two fixed Ridge fits, one paired bootstrap and no account. Any failed information gate closes this version without sign, window, source-age, HHI/top5, or model tuning on reused history. A pass only permits a separately frozen full Stage1-derived 0bp Tiered-fee account with SOXX hard gates; 2/5bp and independent forward evidence remain separate.
